title: O(d/T) Convergence Theory for Diffusion Probabilistic Models under Minimal Assumptions
tldr_zh: 一阶矩有限+ℓ2 score 下 DDPM 的 TV≲d log³T/T+ε_score√logT；换后验方差系数后 d 变内在维数 k
tldr_en: DDPM attains TV rate d/T (k/T with intrinsic dimension k) under finite first moment and L2-accurate scores, bypassing the KL/Girsanov barrier.
key_numbers: TV(p_X1,p_Y1) ≤ c d log³T/T + c ε_score √logT (Thm 1, Eq. 3.1)
TV ≤ c k log³T/T + c ε_score √logT with σ*² = (1−α_t)(α_t−ᾱ_t)/(1−ᾱ_t) (Thm 2, Eq. 3.5)
Assumption 1: E||X0||_2 ≤ T^{c_M}; relaxable to any δ-th moment if T ≫ max{1,1/δ} d log²T
Prior best DDPM TV rate √(d/T) (Benton 2023a); low-dim prior √(k/T) (Potaptchik 2024, Huang 2024b) (Tables 1–2)
KL between forward/reverse paths ≥ Ω(d/T) even for Gaussian target (cites Chen 2022 Thm 7)
